sdk.list_tools_source:
async def list_tools(self) -> list[MCPTool]:
        """List all available tools."""
        tools = self._tool_manager.list_tools()
        return [
            MCPTool(
                name=info.name,
                description=info.description,
                inputSchema=info.parameters,
            )
            for info in tools
        ]

public_tools.name: add_controlrig_rigvm_links
public_tools.description:
Add ControlRig RigVM links on a sample/temp ControlRig Blueprint.

        This command is a guarded writer. It refuses targets outside
        /Game/_MCP_Sample and /Game/_MCP_Temp, validates all requested links
        before mutation, and then calls Unreal's RigVM controller AddLink only
        for links that are feasible and not already connected. It does not
        create cast nodes, execute, solve, or modify original assets.

        Args:
            control_rig_path: Sample/temp ControlRig Blueprint asset path or generated class path
            control_rig_asset_path: Explicit ControlRig Blueprint asset path alias
            control_rig_class_path: Generated ControlRig class path alias
            links: Link specs with source_pin_path/from and target_pin_path/to, or "Source -> Target" strings
            unit_links: Alias for links, useful when applying reviewed unit link specs
            allow_type_casting: Allow type casting in feasibility checks; cast node creation remains disabled
            dry_run: Validate and report planned writes without mutation
            compile: Compile/reinitialize the target ControlRig after successful mutation
            save_asset: Save only the target sample/temp ControlRig asset after successful mutation
            max_links: Maximum link specs to process

        Returns:
            Sample/temp ControlRig RigVM link writer response.

Apply an allowlisted native-node recipe to one Custom HLSL node in a ghost system.

        Args:
            system_path: Target under /Game/_MCP_Temp/NiagaraGenerated only
            custom_hlsl_node_guid: Exact Custom HLSL node GUID from inspection
            nodes: Native graph-action nodes with node_id, action_id, optional x/y/defaults
            links: Source/target endpoint objects connecting created nodes or Custom HLSL inputs
            output_mappings: Mapping from every converted Custom HLSL output to its native source
            scratch_pad_name: Optional exact Scratch Pad script name selector
            scratch_pad_script_path: Optional exact private Scratch Pad object path selector
            scratch_pad_script_index: Optional system-owned Scratch Pad index selector
            expected_hlsl_body_hash: Required dry-run/readback hash when dry_run is false
            dry_run: Validate selectors and action ids without mutating; defaults true
            remove_custom_hlsl: Remove the converted node after pre-removal compile validation
            save: Save only after final compile, pending-ID binding, and dependency checks pass
            request_compile: Apply mode requires owning-system compile validation
            timeout_seconds: Maximum wait for each compile phase
            poll_interval_seconds: Niagara compilation polling interval

        Apply uses non-force owning-system compiles and proves that each caller's
        pending ComputedId becomes the post-compile CachedId/ComputedId. After any
        post-mutation failure it restores visible graph structure, keeps the ghost
        package dirty, and requires an exact package reload; Undo alone is unproven
        and it never reports a clean full rollback.

public_tools.name: configure_chaos_cloth_component
public_tools.description:
Plan or apply guarded Chaos Cloth component/runtime-property changes.

        ``component_settings`` accepts enable/suspend booleans, environment
        collision, geometry scale (0..10000), teleport distance (>=0), teleport
        rotation (0..180), and ``teleport_action``. Each ``property_updates``
        entry supplies ``name``, ``value_type`` (float, weighted_float, int,
        bool, vector, or string), its typed value, and optional LOD and
        ``expected_current``. At most 256 entries are accepted, and
        duplicate/overlapping LOD updates are rejected.
        Runtime collection updates plus one-shot ``teleport`` and
        ``teleport_and_reset`` actions are transient and cannot be persisted
        alone with ``save_level``; ``reset_mode`` and serialized component
        settings are durable. Intrinsic runtime-property changes require
        explicit simulation recreation approval. ``recreate_simulation`` is
        ``auto``, ``always``, or ``never``. Apply requires ``dry_run=False``
        and every mutation is verified by native readback.

public_tools.name: configure_chaos_cloth_dataflow_node
public_tools.description:
Plan or apply typed-export-text changes to one reviewed Cloth Dataflow node.

        At most 64 values are accepted, and each must be an Unreal export-text
        string. Apply mode also requires the
        exact node type and Dataflow asset path returned by inspection, with
        regeneration enabled. Connected inputs require explicit opt-in, while a
        Dataflow graph referenced by another package is always blocked because
        only the selected Cloth Asset can be regenerated safely. After an apply,
        regeneration, readback, or save failure, the native handler attempts to
        restore the selected properties and regenerate the original Cloth Asset;
        inspect the returned ``rollback_*`` evidence before continuing.

public_tools.name: configure_chaos_cloth_weight_map

Plan or apply one durable Chaos Cloth Dataflow weight-map update.

        Supply exactly one normalized ``[0,1]`` source: ``weights`` or
        ``fill_value``. Apply mode is guarded by exact Dataflow/node identity,
        vertex count, topology MD5, generated weight-map MD5, node-state MD5,
        and the exact downstream ``path_md5`` copied from a fresh dry-run. By default,
        the selected map must remain bound to the generated runtime cloth
        collection. Native regeneration, independent readback, rollback, and
        optional asset saves are reported with ``mutation_result_v1``.

public_tools.name: configure_chaos_solver_settings

        ``settings`` accepts iteration counts (0..255), non-negative collision,
        cluster, and event-filter numbers, ``cluster_union_connection_type`` as
        an inspected enum name, generation/filter booleans, non-negative break
        limits, and throttle counts of -1 or non-negative integers. Initial
        overlap depenetration accepts -1 or a non-negative number. Collision
        margins, runtime determinism, and CVar writes are intentionally blocked.
        Use the inspector's flat ``expected_current_fields`` for optimistic
        concurrency. Apply requires ``dry_run=False``; persistence additionally

public_tools.name: create_niagara_ndc_reader_scratch_pad_module
public_tools.description:
Create one fresh, system-owned Scratch Pad module for a guarded NDC reader pipeline.

        This mirrors the three module graphs generated by UE 5.6's Niagara Data Channel
        Wizard. Call it once per stage, in canonical order:

        * ``emitter_spawn_init`` exposes ``Module.DataChannel`` and stores it in
          ``Emitter.SpawnDataChannel``.
        * ``emitter_update_spawn`` calls ``SpawnDirect`` using the selected int
          channel variable (for example ``DebrisCount`` or ``DustCount``).
        * ``particle_spawn_read`` calls ``GetNDCSpawnData`` then variadic ``Read`` and
          maps Position, Velocity, SpawnCount, and EventType to particle parameters.

        The command validates a Global NDC and its exact required field types before
        mutation, creates from UE's pristine four-node DefaultModuleScript in transient
        memory, refuses every existing Scratch Pad name, and edits generated/temp systems
        only unless explicitly allowed. It intentionally does not insert the module into
        an emitter stack or bind the first module's DI override; use the structured
        ``required_follow_up`` response with ``add_scratch_pad_module_to_stack`` and
        ``set_niagara_data_interface_module_input``.

        Args:
            system_path: Existing target Niagara System package or object path.
            scratch_pad_name: New ASCII-only Scratch Pad name; overwrite is never allowed.
            data_channel_asset_path: Existing Global Niagara Data Channel asset.
            stage: emitter_spawn_init, emitter_update_spawn, or particle_spawn_read.
            position_variable: Position-typed NDC field name.
            velocity_variable: Vector-typed NDC field name.
            spawn_count_variable: Int-typed NDC field used by SpawnDirect.
            event_type_variable: Int-typed NDC event discriminator.
            position_target: Particle target for Position reads.
            velocity_target: Particle target for Velocity reads.
            spawn_count_target: Particle target retaining the source SpawnCount.
            event_type_target: Particle target retaining EventType.
            read_success_target: Particle bool target for the Read success output.
            read_current_frame: DI override value to use during the documented follow-up.
                False requires the channel to keep previous-frame data.
            dry_run: Validate system, name, template, signatures, and NDC schema only.
            allow_source_edit: Allow editing systems outside /Game/_MCP_Temp/NiagaraGenerated/.
            save: Save the target system after adding the authored Scratch Pad.
            request_compile: Request Niagara compilation after adding the Scratch Pad.

            twist_limit_degrees: Twist angular limit
            linear_damping: Per-body linear damping
            angular_damping: Per-body angular damping
            tip_mass_scale: Mass scale for the final generated body
            overwrite_existing: Rebuild an existing PhysicsAsset in place

public_tools.name: dry_run_blueprint_niagara_component_template_asset_swap
public_tools.description:
Dry-run a reviewed Blueprint Niagara component-template asset swap.

        This guarded preflight loads the Blueprint plus source/replacement
        Niagara Systems, resolves the matching SCS UNiagaraComponent template,
        snapshots its current asset assignment and override parameter store, and
        reports the planned replacement. It does not call SetAsset, compile,
        save, reload, or persist any project content.

        Args:
            blueprint_path: Blueprint asset package or object path.
            component_name: Required substring filter for the SCS Niagara component template, e.g. RainFX.
            source_system_path: Niagara System currently expected on the component template.
            replacement_system_path: Niagara System that would be assigned by a future reviewed executor.
            confirmation_token: Must be ALLOW_DURABLE_BP_COMPONENT_TEMPLATE_MUTATION.
            operation: Reviewed operation name. Defaults to durable_bp_component_template_asset_swap.
            dry_run: Must remain true. False is rejected by the native command.
            preserve_override_parameters: Must remain true to preserve component template override state.
            allow_unrealmcp_dependency: Must remain false; finished assets must not depend on UnrealMCP.
            parameter_name_contains: Optional substring filter for override parameter names.
            include_inherited_scs_templates: Include parent Blueprint SCS templates as resolved for the target generated class.
            require_exactly_one: Require exactly one matching component template.
            require_source_system_match: Require matching templates to use source_system_path.
            max_components: Maximum matching component templates to return.
            max_parameters: Maximum parameters to return per override store.
            include_parameter_values: Include decoded primitive/vector/color parameter values.
            include_raw_bytes: Include raw byte previews for unsupported parameter types.
            max_raw_bytes: Maximum bytes per unsupported parameter raw preview.
            include_parameter_object_properties: Include limited UPROPERTY previews for UObject/DataInterface parameter values.
            include_component_object_properties: Include limited reflected properties from the component template itself.
            max_object_properties: Maximum UObject/DataInterface or component properties to return.
            max_array_elements: Maximum array elements to sample per reflected property.
            max_property_value_chars: Maximum export-text characters per reflected property value.

            overwrite_existing: Delete and recreate an existing target sample AnimBP
            compile: Compile the target sample AnimBP after edits
            save_asset: Save the target sample AnimBP after edits
            dry_run: Validate request and return planned edits without mutating assets

public_tools.name: ensure_blueprint_rigid_constraint_chain
public_tools.description:
Author an anchored StaticMesh rigid-body chain in an Actor Blueprint.

        The first body is kinematic and every following body simulates physics.
        Adjacent bodies are joined by engine PhysicsConstraintComponents at the
        child body's relative location. Linear motion is locked, angular motion
        is limited, self/world collision responses are ignored, and simple
        collision is required on every source StaticMesh so Chaos still has
        physical bodies and inertia.

        Each body_components item requires component_name, static_mesh, and
        relative_location=[X,Y,Z]. Optional keys are relative_rotation,
        mass_kg, and simulate_physics; when supplied, simulate_physics must be
        false for the first item and true for every later item.

        dry_run defaults to true and performs all asset, collision, topology,
        name-collision, and required-root checks without changing the Blueprint.
        Existing body or constraint component names are never overwritten.

public_tools.name: execute_unreal_python
public_tools.description:
Execute Python inside the running Unreal Editor.

        Source-code text is not used to decide import safety because aliases,
        getattr, helpers, and persistent Unreal Python globals can hide the
        eventual engine call. ``auto`` therefore conservatively behaves as
        ``legacy``: it runs standalone on the next editor tick, temporarily
        bypasses Interchange, and verifies restoration. This supports
        AssetImportTask/import_asset_tasks as well as
        AutomatedAssetImportData/import_assets_automated.

        Use ``preserve`` (or its ``interchange`` alias) for synchronous direct
        UInterchangeManager ``import_asset``, ``reimport_asset``, or
        ``import_scene`` calls and formats that require Interchange. A scripted
        async import must wait for completion and perform independent readback
        before the Python call returns; otherwise the bridge reports an unknown
        in-flight mutation and refuses a success result. Use ``none`` only when
        the script cannot import; it is a trusted caller declaration, not a
        sandbox, and avoids the import ticker/CVar scope. Declared import
        policies cannot run inside a synchronous batch/re-entrant command.

        Live Python asset Force Delete, Python-driven editor shutdown, map
        transitions, and unsafe PCG selector mutation remain rejected by focused
        accident guards. Generic Python execution is not a security sandbox.

        Args:
            code: Python code to execute in Unreal.
            mode: Python execution mode. ExecuteFile supports multiline TA scripts.
            defer_to_ticker: Run through Unreal ticker instead of directly on the game thread.
            allow_unsafe_editor_scripting_during_pie: Permit known unsafe editor actor cleanup calls during PIE/SIE.
            interchange_policy: Structured import execution policy. ``auto`` is the conservative legacy-compatible default; ``none`` declares no import; ``legacy`` selects legacy factories; ``preserve``/``interchange`` keep Interchange enabled for synchronous direct imports. Import-capable policies force standalone next-tick dispatch.

        Returns:
            Response from Unreal, including Python logs and command_result.

public_tools.name: plan_niagara_effect
public_tools.description:
Create a grounded, dry-run ParticleEffectSpec for Niagara authoring.

        The planner decomposes an artistic intent into emitter responsibilities,
        module responsibilities, measurable objectives, knowledge topics, and a
        safe follow-up workflow. It does not call an LLM, connect to Unreal, save
        files, or execute mutations. Pass a draft_spec to normalize and validate
        an agent-authored plan against the same contract.

        Args:
            intent: Natural-language artistic and behavioral intent.
            working_path: Optional unused generated temp Niagara path under
                /Game/_MCP_Temp/NiagaraGenerated.
            source_system_path: Optional source Niagara System to inspect or duplicate.
            draft_spec: Optional agent-authored ParticleEffectSpec to normalize.
            material_candidates: Optional project/engine material metadata candidates.
            constraints: Optional constraint overrides; safety invariants remain validated.

public_tools.name: plan_niagara_promotion_manifest

            asset_name_prefix: Prefix for generated target asset names

            forbidden_dependency_prefixes: Additional dependency roots to reject
            forbidden_source_roots: Source/template roots to reject when promoted assets must be independent
            allow_non_temp_source: Allow source systems outside generated temp
            allow_temp_target: Allow promotion targets under /Game/_MCP_Temp
            allow_temp_dependencies: Allow dependencies under /Game/_MCP_Temp
            write_manifest: Also write the JSON manifest under Saved/MCP/NiagaraPromotionManifests
            manifest_name: Optional manifest file name when write_manifest is true
            timeout_seconds: Unreal bridge timeout for each dry-run promotion call

public_tools.name: preview_niagara_component_asset_swap
public_tools.description:
Temporarily preview a Niagara System asset swap on one live component.

        This is an authoring-only BP manager parity route. It finds exactly one
        live editor UNiagaraComponent by the supplied actor/component/system
        filters, assigns the replacement Niagara System with override
        preservation, samples runtime and override state, then restores the
        original asset and active state before returning.

        Args:
            replacement_system_path: Niagara system object path or package path to test on the component.
            actor_name: Optional substring filter against actor name, label, or path.
            actor_label: Optional substring filter against actor label.
            component_name: Optional substring filter against component name or path, e.g. RainFX.
            system_path: Optional substring filter against the currently assigned Niagara system path.
            parameter_name_contains: Optional substring filter for parameter names.
            restore_original_asset: Must remain true. Persistent component asset swaps are not admitted by this tool.
            preserve_override_parameters: Must remain true. False can reset Blueprint component override state.
            activate_after_swap: Activate and advance the component after the temporary swap for runtime readback.
            advance_time: Seconds to advance simulation after the temporary swap.
            advance_tick_delta: Simulation tick size for the advance.
            max_parameters: Maximum parameters to return per store.
            max_emitter_instances: Maximum emitter runtime entries to return per component snapshot.
            include_parameter_values: Include decoded primitive/vector/color parameter values.
            include_raw_bytes: Include raw byte previews for unsupported parameter types.
            max_raw_bytes: Maximum bytes per unsupported parameter raw preview.
            include_parameter_object_properties: Include limited UPROPERTY previews for UObject/DataInterface parameter values.
            include_emitter_runtime: Include live system/emitter counters for the after-swap snapshot.
            max_object_properties: Maximum UObject/DataInterface properties to return per object.
            max_array_elements: Maximum array elements to sample per UObject/DataInterface property.
            max_property_value_chars: Maximum export-text characters per property value.

public_tools.name: preview_niagara_system_in_preview_lab
public_tools.description:
Run a one-call Niagara Preview Lab still preview.

        This optimized route loads a read-only Niagara system, deletes prior
        Preview Lab actors if requested, spawns one transient preview actor,
        applies optional component-only User parameter overrides, advances
        simulation for warmup, captures with auto framing, and optionally
        removes the actor afterward.

        Args:
            system_path: Niagara system object path or package path.
            filepath: PNG output path. Relative paths are resolved under Saved/MCP/NiagaraReviews.
            view: Near/mid/far distance hint, 1 to 3.
            label: Optional preview actor label suffix.
            warmup_time: Seconds to advance simulation before capture.
            warmup_tick_delta: Simulation tick size for warmup.
            cleanup_before: Delete existing Preview Lab actors before spawning.
            cleanup_after: Delete Preview Lab actors after capture.
            location: Optional [x, y, z] spawn location. Defaults to [0, 0, 120].
            scale: Optional [x, y, z] actor scale. Defaults to [1, 1, 1].
            auto_frame: Auto-frame temporary preview actors when present. Set false for manual camera captures.
            camera_location: Optional [x, y, z] capture camera location override.
            camera_rotation: Optional [pitch, yaw, roll] capture camera rotation override.
            camera_fov: Optional capture camera FOV override.
            user_parameter_overrides: Optional transient component overrides, e.g. {"Amount": 90000.0, "Custom Camera Position": [0, -3200, 650]}.
            preserve_override_parameters: Preserve existing component override parameters when assigning the system. Keep true for Blueprint/component swap parity.
            allow_current_map_preview: Allow preview capture in the current editor map when the dedicated Preview Lab map is unavailable.

public_tools.name: sample_anim_node_pre_post_runtime_pose
public_tools.description:
Resolve a target AnimGraph node or run a limited runtime probe.

        With dry_run=True this is a read-only target resolver. With dry_run=False,
        mode="compiled_graph_mapping" maps the selected editor AnimGraph node to
        the compiled/live FAnimNode instance on a matched AnimInstance and reports
        runtime FPoseLink/FComponentSpacePoseLink link IDs plus mapping_support
        diagnostics for PoseWatch eligibility and evidence tier. With
        mode="pose_watch_capture", it temporarily sets the AnimBP debug object,
        registers transient PoseWatch debug entries for the selected compiled
        node output and selected runtime input pose link(s), and samples them
        during the same forced tick without adding PoseWatches to the AnimBP asset.
        With
        mode="active_component_tick_delta" samples final SkeletalMeshComponent pose
        before and after forced ticks on a matched live component. With
        mode="isolated_temp_components", it duplicates the AnimBP under _MCP_Temp,
        bypasses the selected node in a source copy, and compares that against a
        selected-node copy on separate transient components.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Anim Blueprint name or path
            anim_blueprint: Alternative Anim Blueprint name or path
            graph_name: AnimGraph graph name, defaults to AnimGraph
            graph_id: Optional graph GUID
            graph_type: Graph type, defaults to function for AnimGraph
            node_id: Exact target node GUID. Required when filters are ambiguous.
            node_type: Node class/title filter such as AnimGraphNode_RigidBody
            title_contains: Node title substring filter
            sample_bones: Optional future sample bone list echoed in the response
            sample_sockets: Optional future sample socket list echoed in the response
            mode: Runtime mode for dry_run=False. compiled_graph_mapping, pose_watch_capture, active_component_tick_delta, or isolated_temp_components.
            skeletal_mesh: SkeletalMesh path required by isolated_temp_components
            temp_root: Temp asset root for isolated_temp_components
            cleanup: Delete transient actors/temp assets after isolated sampling
            overwrite_existing_temp_assets: Replace colliding temp assets
            run_id: Optional stable suffix for generated temp asset/actor names
            actor_label: Live actor label to sample for active_component_tick_delta
            actor_name: Live actor object name to sample
            actor_path: Live actor object path to sample
            component_name: SkeletalMeshComponent name to sample
            anim_instance_source: AnimInstance source on the sampled component: main or post_process
            prefer_pie_world: Prefer PIE/SIE/play worlds over editor world
            require_pie_world: Refuse editor-world fallback
            tick_count: Forced tick count between pre/post samples
            tick_delta_time: Delta time for forced ticks
            settle_tick_count: Forced ticks before taking the pre sample
            refresh_bone_transforms: Refresh bone transforms after forced ticks
            allow_missing_bones: Return partial samples instead of failing on missing bones/sockets
            pose_link_max_depth: Max struct recursion depth for compiled_graph_mapping and pose_watch_capture runtime pose-link inventory
            input_pose_mode: PoseWatch input selection mode: first or all
            input_pose_field_path: Exact runtime pose-link field path to capture
            input_pose_index: Zero-based valid runtime pose-link index to capture
            include_pins: Include full pin data for the selected node
            max_depth: Reflected settings depth
            dry_run: Resolve only when true; run the selected mode when false

        Returns:
            Resolver response or selected runtime probe response, including
            mapping_support when node attribution diagnostics are available.

Set a narrow set of RigidBody AnimGraph node settings.

        By default this refuses to modify Animation Blueprints outside `/Game/_MCP_Sample/`.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Animation Blueprint name or path
            node_id: Optional RigidBody node GUID filter
            alpha: Optional RigidBody alpha value
            external_force: Optional [X, Y, Z] external force vector
            simulation_space: Optional ComponentSpace, WorldSpace, or BaseBoneSpace
            enable_world_geometry: Optional world geometry collision toggle
            allow_non_sample: Allow editing non-`/Game/_MCP_Sample/` assets
            graph_name: Target animation graph name, defaults to AnimGraph
            graph_id: Optional target graph GUID
            graph_type: Graph selector type, defaults to function

        Returns:
            Response containing updated RigidBody node metadata and reflected settings.

public_tools.name: set_anim_instance_runtime_property_for_probe
public_tools.description:
Set properties on the matched live AnimInstance for runtime probing only.

        This modifies the current runtime object, not the Animation Blueprint asset.

        Args:
            actor_label: Optional actor label filter
            actor_name: Optional actor object name filter
            actor_path: Optional actor path filter
            component_name: Optional SkeletalMeshComponent object name
            properties: Property map such as {"GroundSpeed": 250.0}
            property_name: Single property name alternative
            value: Single property value alternative
            tick_after_set: Force a narrow component animation tick after setting
            tick_count: Number of forced component animation ticks
            tick_delta_time: Delta time per forced tick
            refresh_bone_transforms: Refresh component bone transforms during/after forced ticks when tick_count > 0
            include_snapshot_after: Include state-machine/montage/curve snapshot after the set
            include_previous_values: Include previous property values in the response
            state_machine_name: Optional state-machine name substring filter for snapshots
            include_states: Include per-state metadata in snapshots
            include_state_weights: Include runtime state/machine weights in snapshots
            include_relevant_anim_times: Include relevant asset-player time/remaining values per state in snapshots
            include_transition_progress: Include active transition elapsed/crossfade progress in snapshots
            include_inactive_transition_progress: Include inactive transition progress entries in snapshots
            include_montages: Include active montage data in snapshots
            include_curves: Include curve values in snapshots
            curve_names: Optional curve names for snapshots
            max_transitions_per_machine: Maximum transitions per included machine for transition progress
            prefer_pie_world: Prefer active PIE/SIE/play world before editor world
            require_pie_world: Fail instead of falling back to the editor world when no PIE/SIE/play world matches

        Returns:
            Response containing applied runtime properties and optional post-set snapshot.

public_tools.name: set_blueprint_actor_tick_settings
public_tools.description:
Set Actor CDO tick defaults on a Blueprint without adding runtime dependencies.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Target Blueprint name or object path.
            tick_hz: Desired tick frequency. 60 means TickInterval 1/60.
            tick_interval: Optional explicit TickInterval. Negative values use tick_hz.
            can_ever_tick: PrimaryActorTick.bCanEverTick.
            start_with_tick_enabled: PrimaryActorTick.bStartWithTickEnabled.
            allow_tick_on_dedicated_server: PrimaryActorTick.bAllowTickOnDedicatedServer.
            tick_even_when_paused: PrimaryActorTick.bTickEvenWhenPaused.
            dry_run: Preview changes without mutating the asset.
            compile: Compile after mutation.
            save: Save only after a successful compile.

public_tools.name: set_blueprint_node_positions
public_tools.description:
Guardedly move existing Blueprint nodes without changing graph topology.

        Every update must include node_id, position, expected_position,
        expected_class, and expected_title. Unreal validates the complete batch
        before changing any NodePosX/NodePosY value. Duplicate GUIDs and
        PIE/SIE execution are rejected. The batch is limited to 2048 updates.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Name or asset path of the target Blueprint
            graph_name: Explicit target graph name
            updates: Guarded node position updates
            graph_id: Optional graph GUID used as an additional selector
            graph_type: Optional graph type used as an additional selector
            dry_run: Validate and report without mutation; defaults to True
            compile: Compile after a real edit; defaults to False
            save: Save after a real edit; defaults to False

        Returns:
            Per-node guard/readback results plus compile and save status

public_tools.name: set_controlrig_rigvm_pin_defaults
public_tools.description:
Set ControlRig RigVM pin defaults on a sample/temp ControlRig Blueprint.

        This command is a guarded writer. It refuses targets outside
        /Game/_MCP_Sample and /Game/_MCP_Temp, requires every requested pin spec
        to include a default value, validates all requested defaults before
        mutation, and then calls Unreal's RigVM controller SetPinDefaultValue.
        It does not execute, solve, or modify original assets.

        Args:
            control_rig_path: Sample/temp ControlRig Blueprint asset path or generated class path
            control_rig_asset_path: Explicit ControlRig Blueprint asset path alias
            control_rig_class_path: Generated ControlRig class path alias
            pin_defaults: Pin specs with pin_path/pin/path and default_value/value/default
            defaults: Alias for pin_defaults
            resize_arrays: Permit RigVM array resize while setting defaults
            set_value_on_linked_pins: Propagate value to linked pins
            dry_run: Validate and report planned writes without mutation
            compile: Compile/reinitialize the target ControlRig after successful mutation
            save_asset: Save only the target sample/temp ControlRig asset after successful mutation
            max_pins: Maximum pin specs to process

        Returns:
            Sample/temp ControlRig RigVM pin-default writer response.

public_tools.name: set_niagara_data_interface_module_input

            input_name: DI module input name, with or without the Module. prefix

            emitter_index: Optional target emitter index
            emitter_name: Optional target emitter name
            module_index: Optional target module index from inspect_niagara_module_inputs
            module_name: Optional target module name
            module_node_guid: Optional target module node GUID
            overwrite_existing: Replace an existing linked override for the module input

            save: Save the Niagara System after editing
            request_compile: Request Niagara compile after editing
            wait_for_completion: Wait for compile completion
            timeout_seconds: Compile wait timeout

public_tools.name: set_niagara_emitter_fixed_bounds
public_tools.description:
Set a Niagara emitter's fixed bounds and/or CalculateBoundsMode.

        min/max are [x, y, z] world-space corners and must be provided together.
        mode is "Dynamic", "Fixed", or "Programmable"; providing min/max defaults the
        mode to Fixed. Fixed bounds are required for GPU emitters. Editor-only.

        Args:
            system_path: Niagara System package/object path
            min: [x, y, z] minimum corner (with max)
            max: [x, y, z] maximum corner (with min)
            mode: Optional CalculateBoundsMode (Dynamic|Fixed|Programmable)
            emitter_index: Optional target emitter index
            emitter_name: Optional target emitter display name
            allow_source_edit: Allow edits outside /Game/_MCP_Temp
            save: Save the Niagara System after editing
            request_compile: Request a compile after editing

public_tools.name: set_niagara_emitter_local_space

Set a Niagara emitter's Local Space flag (FVersionedNiagaraEmitterData.bLocalSpace).

        Local space makes the particle field move rigidly with the component, so a
        camera-following weather system tracks smoothly (no world-space fill-in lag).
        Editor-only. Targets one emitter by emitter_index and/or emitter_name.

        Args:
            system_path: Niagara System package/object path
            value: True for local space, False for world space
            emitter_index: Optional target emitter index
            emitter_name: Optional target emitter display name
            allow_source_edit: Allow edits outside /Game/_MCP_Temp
            save: Save the Niagara System after editing
            request_compile: Request a compile after editing

public_tools.name: set_niagara_emitter_sim_target
public_tools.description:
Set a Niagara emitter's SimTarget ("CPU" or "GPU").

        GPU compute sim is far cheaper for high particle counts (weather, rain/snow).
        GPU cannot use Dynamic bounds; with auto_fixed_bounds=True the bounds mode is
        switched to Fixed (default bounds if none set) automatically. Editor-only.

        Args:
            system_path: Niagara System package/object path
            sim_target: "CPU" (CPUSim) or "GPU" (GPUComputeSim)
            auto_fixed_bounds: If GPU + Dynamic bounds, auto-switch to Fixed instead of erroring
            emitter_index: Optional target emitter index
            emitter_name: Optional target emitter display name
            allow_source_edit: Allow edits outside /Game/_MCP_Temp
            save: Save the Niagara System after editing
            request_compile: Request a compile after editing

public_tools.name: set_niagara_module_static_switch
public_tools.description:
Set (or list) a Niagara module static-switch value on a particle/emitter module.

        Static switches (e.g. InitializeParticle "Sprite Size Mode") gate which inputs
        compile and are NOT RapidIteration-writable, so this is the only way to flip
        them via MCP. Enum values accept a display name, internal name, or exact integer
        value and are canonicalized against the pin's UEnum before mutation. Editor-only.

        Discovery: call with no input_name/value to list the module's static switches,
        each with current_value and (for enums) the available options.

        Args:
            system_path: Niagara System package/object path
            input_name: Static switch input name (omit to list)
            value: New enum display/internal name, enum integer, or boolean; omit to list
            emitter_index / emitter_name: Target emitter
            module_index / module_name / module_node_guid: Target module
            expected_current_value: Optional exact raw current_value stale-write guard
            allow_source_edit: Allow edits outside /Game/_MCP_Temp
            save: Save after editing
            request_compile: Request compile after editing
            wait_for_completion: Wait for Niagara compile completion before saving
            timeout_seconds: Compile wait timeout, clamped by the editor bridge
            poll_interval_seconds: Compile wait poll interval
            require_compile_gate_for_save: Require request+wait when saving a mutation

public_tools.name: validate_controlrig_rigvm_links

Validate proposed ControlRig RigVM links without mutating the graph.

        This command is read-only. It resolves a ControlRig Blueprint asset or
        generated ControlRig class, finds the requested RigVM pins, reports
        existing-link state, and calls Unreal's RigVM CanLink path for each
        bounded link spec. It does not add links, compile, save, execute, or
        solve the ControlRig.

        Args:
            control_rig_path: ControlRig Blueprint asset path or generated class path
            control_rig_asset_path: Explicit ControlRig Blueprint asset path alias
            control_rig_class_path: Generated ControlRig class path alias
            links: Link specs with source_pin_path/from and target_pin_path/to, or "Source -> Target" strings
            unit_links: Alias for links, useful when checking previously rejected unit link specs
            allow_type_casting: Allow RigVM type casting during CanLink validation
            max_links: Maximum link specs to validate

        Returns:
            Read-only ControlRig RigVM link feasibility response.

public_tools.name: validate_controlrig_rigvm_pin_defaults
public_tools.description:
Validate ControlRig RigVM pin default feasibility without writing values.

        This command is read-only. It resolves a ControlRig Blueprint asset or
        generated ControlRig class, finds requested RigVM pins, reports current
        default value metadata, and validates any proposed default strings with
        Unreal's RigVM pin default-value checks. It does not call
        SetPinDefaultValue, resize arrays, compile, save, execute, or solve.

        Args:
            control_rig_path: ControlRig Blueprint asset path or generated class path
            control_rig_asset_path: Explicit ControlRig Blueprint asset path alias
            control_rig_class_path: Generated ControlRig class path alias
            pin_defaults: Pin specs with pin_path/pin/path and optional default_value/value/default
            defaults: Alias for pin_defaults
            pins: Alias for pin_defaults, useful for read-only pin capability checks
            max_pins: Maximum pin specs to validate

        Returns:
            Read-only ControlRig RigVM pin default feasibility response.

public_tools.name: validate_controlrig_solver_intents
public_tools.description:
Validate future ControlRig solver intents through the UnrealMCP native bridge.

        This is a validation-only UnrealMCP C++ route. It accepts a request or
        recipe-like object with solver_gate and solver_intents, verifies that the
        intents are limited to validation-only candidates, rejects materialized
        solver RigVM units, and reports that sample/temp live proof is still
        required before any build path may add solver units.

        Args:
            request: JSON object or string with target_control_rig_path,
                solver_gate, solver_intents, and optional recipe hierarchy.

public_tools.name: validate_niagara_effect_patch
public_tools.description:
Validate an objective-based Niagara patch without executing it.

        Every objective must define a measurable expected observation and a
        rollback policy. Operations are restricted to the existing reviewed
        Niagara command allowlist, share one exact system path, and default to
        generated temp content. A valid response includes a non-dispatched
        execute_batch manifest; execution always requires a separate explicit
        tool call.

        Args:
            patch: Versioned objective-patch object.
            effect_spec: Optional ParticleEffectSpec for exact working-path binding.
            allow_non_temp_target: Validate a non-temp path for planning only;
                this never approves or performs mutation and does not bypass promotion.

public_tools.name: validate_niagara_effect_spec
public_tools.description:
Validate a ParticleEffectSpec and its emitter dependency graph.

        Validation covers schema version, emitter/objective identity, module
        stages, material and system asset paths, dependency cycles, temp working
        scope, promotion requirements, plugin independence, selective rollback,
        and best-state selection. This tool is mutation-free.

public_tools.name: wrap_niagara_scratch_pad_output_with_stack_context
public_tools.description:
Wrap a Scratch Pad ParameterMapSet value input with a Custom HLSL accumulator.

        The existing linked value becomes local_value_pin_name, while the expression can
        read the incoming StackContext through the dynamic input's ParameterMap.

        Args:
            system_path: Niagara System package path or object path
            target_pin_name: ParameterMapSet input pin to wrap, defaults to StackContext.RGBA
            scratch_pad_script_path: Direct target Scratch Pad script path
            scratch_pad_owner_kind: system or emitter
            scratch_pad_script_index: Scratch Pad script index
            scratch_pad_name: Scratch Pad script name, defaults to RenderCircleToGrid
            scratch_pad_emitter_index: Optional emitter index for emitter-owned Scratch Pads
            scratch_pad_emitter_name: Optional emitter name for emitter-owned Scratch Pads
            target_node_guid: Optional target ParameterMapSet node GUID
            target_node_index: Optional graph node index from inspect_niagara_graph
            parameter_map_set_index: Optional ParameterMapSet-only index in the Scratch Pad graph
            previous_stack_value_pin_name: Custom HLSL input name for the incoming StackContext value
            local_value_pin_name: Custom HLSL input name for the previous linked value
            expression: Dynamic Custom HLSL expression, defaults to max(PreviousStackValue, LocalStampValue)
            skip_if_already_wrapped: Return success when the same Custom HLSL wrapper already exists
            replace_existing_custom: Replace an existing Custom HLSL wrapper while preserving local_value_pin_name
            allow_source_edit: Allow edits outside /Game/_MCP_Temp
            save: Save the Niagara System after editing
            request_compile: Request Niagara compile after editing

        This command is a guarded writer. It refuses targets outside

        before mutation, and then calls Unreal's RigVM controller AddLink only
        for links that are feasible and not already connected. It does not
        create cast nodes, execute, solve, or modify original assets.

        Args:
            control_rig_path: Sample/temp ControlRig Blueprint asset path or generated class path
            control_rig_asset_path: Explicit ControlRig Blueprint asset path alias
            control_rig_class_path: Generated ControlRig class path alias
            links: Link specs with source_pin_path/from and target_pin_path/to, or "Source -> Target" strings
            unit_links: Alias for links, useful when applying reviewed unit link specs
            allow_type_casting: Allow type casting in feasibility checks; cast node creation remains disabled
            dry_run: Validate and report planned writes without mutation
            compile: Compile/reinitialize the target ControlRig after successful mutation
            save_asset: Save only the target sample/temp ControlRig asset after successful mutation
            max_links: Maximum link specs to process

        Returns:
            Sample/temp ControlRig RigVM link writer response.

catalog_tools.description:
Apply an allowlisted native-node recipe to one Custom HLSL node in a ghost system.

        Args:
            system_path: Target under /Game/_MCP_Temp/NiagaraGenerated only
            custom_hlsl_node_guid: Exact Custom HLSL node GUID from inspection
            nodes: Native graph-action nodes with node_id, action_id, optional x/y/defaults
            links: Source/target endpoint objects connecting created nodes or Custom HLSL inputs
            output_mappings: Mapping from every converted Custom HLSL output to its native source
            scratch_pad_name: Optional exact Scratch Pad script name selector
            scratch_pad_script_path: Optional exact private Scratch Pad object path selector
            scratch_pad_script_index: Optional system-owned Scratch Pad index selector
            expected_hlsl_body_hash: Required dry-run/readback hash when dry_run is false
            dry_run: Validate selectors and action ids without mutating; defaults true
            remove_custom_hlsl: Remove the converted node after pre-removal compile validation
            save: Save only after final compile, pending-ID binding, and dependency checks pass
            request_compile: Apply mode requires owning-system compile validation
            timeout_seconds: Maximum wait for each compile phase
            poll_interval_seconds: Niagara compilation polling interval

        Apply uses non-force owning-system compiles and proves that each caller's
        pending ComputedId becomes the post-compile CachedId/ComputedId. After any
        post-mutation failure it restores visible graph structure, keeps the ghost
        package dirty, and requires an exact package reload; Undo alone is unproven
        and it never reports a clean full rollback.

catalog_tools.name: configure_chaos_cloth_component
catalog_tools.description:
Plan or apply guarded Chaos Cloth component/runtime-property changes.

        ``component_settings`` accepts enable/suspend booleans, environment
        collision, geometry scale (0..10000), teleport distance (>=0), teleport
        rotation (0..180), and ``teleport_action``. Each ``property_updates``
        entry supplies ``name``, ``value_type`` (float, weighted_float, int,
        bool, vector, or string), its typed value, and optional LOD and
        ``expected_current``. At most 256 entries are accepted, and
        duplicate/overlapping LOD updates are rejected.
        Runtime collection updates plus one-shot ``teleport`` and
        ``teleport_and_reset`` actions are transient and cannot be persisted
        alone with ``save_level``; ``reset_mode`` and serialized component
        settings are durable. Intrinsic runtime-property changes require
        explicit simulation recreation approval. ``recreate_simulation`` is
        ``auto``, ``always``, or ``never``. Apply requires ``dry_run=False``
        and every mutation is verified by native readback.

catalog_tools.name: configure_chaos_cloth_dataflow_node
catalog_tools.description:
Plan or apply typed-export-text changes to one reviewed Cloth Dataflow node.

        At most 64 values are accepted, and each must be an Unreal export-text
        string. Apply mode also requires the
        exact node type and Dataflow asset path returned by inspection, with
        regeneration enabled. Connected inputs require explicit opt-in, while a
        Dataflow graph referenced by another package is always blocked because
        only the selected Cloth Asset can be regenerated safely. After an apply,
        regeneration, readback, or save failure, the native handler attempts to
        restore the selected properties and regenerate the original Cloth Asset;
        inspect the returned ``rollback_*`` evidence before continuing.

catalog_tools.name: configure_chaos_cloth_weight_map
catalog_tools.description:
Plan or apply one durable Chaos Cloth Dataflow weight-map update.

        Supply exactly one normalized ``[0,1]`` source: ``weights`` or
        ``fill_value``. Apply mode is guarded by exact Dataflow/node identity,
        vertex count, topology MD5, generated weight-map MD5, node-state MD5,
        and the exact downstream ``path_md5`` copied from a fresh dry-run. By default,
        the selected map must remain bound to the generated runtime cloth
        collection. Native regeneration, independent readback, rollback, and
        optional asset saves are reported with ``mutation_result_v1``.

catalog_tools.name: configure_chaos_solver_settings

Plan or apply an allowlisted Chaos Solver patch with strict readback.

        ``settings`` accepts iteration counts (0..255), non-negative collision,
        cluster, and event-filter numbers, ``cluster_union_connection_type`` as
        an inspected enum name, generation/filter booleans, non-negative break
        limits, and throttle counts of -1 or non-negative integers. Initial
        overlap depenetration accepts -1 or a non-negative number. Collision
        margins, runtime determinism, and CVar writes are intentionally blocked.
        Use the inspector's flat ``expected_current_fields`` for optimistic
        concurrency. Apply requires ``dry_run=False``; persistence additionally
        requires ``save_level=True`` in the editor world.

catalog_tools.name: create_niagara_ndc_reader_scratch_pad_module
catalog_tools.description:
Create one fresh, system-owned Scratch Pad module for a guarded NDC reader pipeline.

        This mirrors the three module graphs generated by UE 5.6's Niagara Data Channel
        Wizard. Call it once per stage, in canonical order:

        * ``emitter_spawn_init`` exposes ``Module.DataChannel`` and stores it in
          ``Emitter.SpawnDataChannel``.
        * ``emitter_update_spawn`` calls ``SpawnDirect`` using the selected int
          channel variable (for example ``DebrisCount`` or ``DustCount``).
        * ``particle_spawn_read`` calls ``GetNDCSpawnData`` then variadic ``Read`` and
          maps Position, Velocity, SpawnCount, and EventType to particle parameters.

        The command validates a Global NDC and its exact required field types before
        mutation, creates from UE's pristine four-node DefaultModuleScript in transient
        memory, refuses every existing Scratch Pad name, and edits generated/temp systems
        only unless explicitly allowed. It intentionally does not insert the module into
        an emitter stack or bind the first module's DI override; use the structured
        ``required_follow_up`` response with ``add_scratch_pad_module_to_stack`` and
        ``set_niagara_data_interface_module_input``.

        Args:
            system_path: Existing target Niagara System package or object path.
            scratch_pad_name: New ASCII-only Scratch Pad name; overwrite is never allowed.
            data_channel_asset_path: Existing Global Niagara Data Channel asset.
            stage: emitter_spawn_init, emitter_update_spawn, or particle_spawn_read.
            position_variable: Position-typed NDC field name.
            velocity_variable: Vector-typed NDC field name.
            spawn_count_variable: Int-typed NDC field used by SpawnDirect.
            event_type_variable: Int-typed NDC event discriminator.
            position_target: Particle target for Position reads.
            velocity_target: Particle target for Velocity reads.
            spawn_count_target: Particle target retaining the source SpawnCount.
            event_type_target: Particle target retaining EventType.
            read_success_target: Particle bool target for the Read success output.
            read_current_frame: DI override value to use during the documented follow-up.
                False requires the channel to keep previous-frame data.
            dry_run: Validate system, name, template, signatures, and NDC schema only.
            allow_source_edit: Allow editing systems outside /Game/_MCP_Temp/NiagaraGenerated/.
            save: Save the target system after adding the authored Scratch Pad.
            request_compile: Request Niagara compilation after adding the Scratch Pad.

catalog_tools.name: dry_run_blueprint_niagara_component_template_asset_swap
catalog_tools.description:
Dry-run a reviewed Blueprint Niagara component-template asset swap.

        This guarded preflight loads the Blueprint plus source/replacement
        Niagara Systems, resolves the matching SCS UNiagaraComponent template,
        snapshots its current asset assignment and override parameter store, and
        reports the planned replacement. It does not call SetAsset, compile,
        save, reload, or persist any project content.

        Args:
            blueprint_path: Blueprint asset package or object path.
            component_name: Required substring filter for the SCS Niagara component template, e.g. RainFX.
            source_system_path: Niagara System currently expected on the component template.
            replacement_system_path: Niagara System that would be assigned by a future reviewed executor.
            confirmation_token: Must be ALLOW_DURABLE_BP_COMPONENT_TEMPLATE_MUTATION.
            operation: Reviewed operation name. Defaults to durable_bp_component_template_asset_swap.
            dry_run: Must remain true. False is rejected by the native command.
            preserve_override_parameters: Must remain true to preserve component template override state.
            allow_unrealmcp_dependency: Must remain false; finished assets must not depend on UnrealMCP.
            parameter_name_contains: Optional substring filter for override parameter names.
            include_inherited_scs_templates: Include parent Blueprint SCS templates as resolved for the target generated class.
            require_exactly_one: Require exactly one matching component template.
            require_source_system_match: Require matching templates to use source_system_path.
            max_components: Maximum matching component templates to return.
            max_parameters: Maximum parameters to return per override store.
            include_parameter_values: Include decoded primitive/vector/color parameter values.
            include_raw_bytes: Include raw byte previews for unsupported parameter types.
            max_raw_bytes: Maximum bytes per unsupported parameter raw preview.
            include_parameter_object_properties: Include limited UPROPERTY previews for UObject/DataInterface parameter values.
            include_component_object_properties: Include limited reflected properties from the component template itself.
            max_object_properties: Maximum UObject/DataInterface or component properties to return.
            max_array_elements: Maximum array elements to sample per reflected property.
            max_property_value_chars: Maximum export-text characters per reflected property value.

catalog_tools.name: ensure_anim_bp_event_graph_locomotion_driver
catalog_tools.description:
Create or reuse a sample-only AnimBP EventGraph locomotion driver.

        The source AnimBP is read-only. The command duplicates or reuses a target
        AnimBP under /Game/_MCP_Sample or /Game/_MCP_Temp, ensures a float Speed
        variable by default, can optionally ensure float Direction and bool
        IsInAir, Acceleration, and IsAccelerating variables, authors Event Blueprint Update Animation ->
        TryGetPawnOwner -> optional IsValid Branch -> GetVelocity -> VSizeXY ->
        Set Speed plus optional CalculateDirection, IsFalling, and
        CharacterMovement acceleration setters using standard engine Blueprint
        nodes, compiles, optionally saves, and reads back EventGraph topology.

        Args:
            source_anim_bp_path: Source Animation Blueprint path or name
            target_anim_bp_path: Optional explicit target sample AnimBP package path
            target_root: Default target folder when target_anim_bp_path is omitted
            variant_name: Name segment used for generated target path
            speed_variable: Float variable updated from pawn XY velocity length
            create_variable_if_missing: Add speed_variable when it does not exist
            include_direction: Also update direction_variable from CalculateDirection(Velocity, ActorRotation)
            direction_variable: Float variable updated when include_direction is true
            create_direction_variable_if_missing: Add direction_variable when it does not exist
            include_is_in_air: Also update is_in_air_variable from MovementComponent.IsFalling()
            is_in_air_variable: Bool variable updated when include_is_in_air is true
            create_is_in_air_variable_if_missing: Add is_in_air_variable when it does not exist
            include_acceleration: Also update acceleration_variable from CharacterMovement.GetCurrentAcceleration XY length
            acceleration_variable: Float variable updated when include_acceleration is true
            create_acceleration_variable_if_missing: Add acceleration_variable when it does not exist
            include_is_accelerating: Also update is_accelerating_variable from acceleration > threshold
            is_accelerating_variable: Bool variable updated when include_is_accelerating is true
            create_is_accelerating_variable_if_missing: Add is_accelerating_variable when it does not exist
            is_accelerating_threshold: Acceleration magnitude threshold for is_accelerating_variable
            guard_pawn_owner: Gate Set Speed behind IsValid(TryGetPawnOwner())
            replace_existing_links: Replace conflicting pins inside the sample target graph
            allow_existing_target_reuse: Reuse an existing sample target AnimBP
            overwrite_existing: Delete and recreate an existing target sample AnimBP
            compile: Compile the target sample AnimBP after edits
            save_asset: Save the target sample AnimBP after edits
            dry_run: Validate request and return planned edits without mutating assets
            validate_only: Alias for dry_run

catalog_tools.name: ensure_anim_graph_secondary_motion_chain

Ensure a reference-pose secondary-motion chain in an Animation Blueprint.

        The authored topology is Local Ref Pose -> Local To Component Space ->
        AnimDynamics or KawaiiPhysics -> Component To Local Space -> Result.
        AnimDynamics is authored with a world-space, gravity-driven constrained
        chain. KawaiiPhysics is an optional plugin and is discovered/configured
        reflectively so UnrealMCP itself does not depend on it.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Animation Blueprint name or path
            dynamics_type: anim_dynamics or kawaii_physics

            linear_damping: AnimDynamics linear damping override (minimum effective value 0.7)
            angular_damping: AnimDynamics angular damping override (minimum effective value 0.7)
            kawaii_damping: KawaiiPhysics damping
            kawaii_stiffness: KawaiiPhysics stiffness
            graph_name: Target graph, defaults to AnimGraph
            graph_id: Optional graph GUID selector
            graph_type: Graph selector type
            replace_existing: Replace conflicting pose links on the authored chain
            allow_non_sample: Explicitly allow intentional edits outside _MCP sample/temp folders
            compile: Compile after graph mutation
            save: Save only after a successful compile

        Returns:
            Node topology/settings, optional-plugin availability, compile/save readback, and MCP-dependency guard.

catalog_tools.name: ensure_anim_state_machine_sample_variant

catalog_tools.name: ensure_blueprint_rigid_constraint_chain
catalog_tools.description:
Author an anchored StaticMesh rigid-body chain in an Actor Blueprint.

        The first body is kinematic and every following body simulates physics.
        Adjacent bodies are joined by engine PhysicsConstraintComponents at the
        child body's relative location. Linear motion is locked, angular motion
        is limited, self/world collision responses are ignored, and simple
        collision is required on every source StaticMesh so Chaos still has
        physical bodies and inertia.

        Each body_components item requires component_name, static_mesh, and
        relative_location=[X,Y,Z]. Optional keys are relative_rotation,
        mass_kg, and simulate_physics; when supplied, simulate_physics must be
        false for the first item and true for every later item.

        dry_run defaults to true and performs all asset, collision, topology,
        name-collision, and required-root checks without changing the Blueprint.
        Existing body or constraint component names are never overwritten.

catalog_tools.name: ensure_controlrig_sample_asset
catalog_tools.description:
Create or reuse a sample-only ControlRig Blueprint asset.

        Creates a ControlRig Blueprint under /Game/_MCP_Sample or
        /Game/_MCP_Temp, optionally assigns a preview SkeletalMesh or imports
        a bounded preview hierarchy from a read-only SkeletalMesh/Skeleton,
        optionally adds bounded direct hierarchy curves, local/global transform
        nulls, direct float/bool/euler transform controls, or a bounded
        allowlisted single-instance ControlRig event RigVM unit node evidence pass,
        compiles or initializes it, optionally saves only the target, and
        returns generated class/readback evidence. Direct null/control objects
        may include parent/parent_name as a string resolved to an existing or
        earlier direct Bone/Null/Control hierarchy key. Direct null objects may
        include transform/global_transform/local_transform. Direct control
        objects may include shape_name, shape_color, and shape_transform
        metadata; transform controls accept transform objects only through
        value/default_value/initial_value/default. RigVM unit_nodes accepts only
        allowlisted single-instance event units such as begin_execution,
        pre_begin_execution, post_begin_execution, prepare_for_execution,
        post_prepare_for_execution, and inverse_execution, with optional name
        and position. Control transform fields, proxy/channel controls, arbitrary
        RigVM script structs, links, variables, functions, comments, reroutes,
        dispatch nodes, exposed pins, and graph replacement remain unsupported.

        Args:
            target_control_rig_path: Target sample ControlRig package path
            skeletal_mesh_path: Optional read-only SkeletalMesh used as preview input
            skeleton_path: Optional read-only Skeleton used for validation
            preview_skeletal_mesh_path: Optional explicit preview mesh override
            setup_mode: empty, empty_with_preview, or import_preview_hierarchy
            curves: Optional direct curve names or objects with name/value
            nulls: Optional direct null names or objects with name, optional parent/parent_name, and optional transform/global_transform/local_transform
            controls: Optional direct float/bool/euler transform control names or objects with name, value/default_value, optional parent/parent_name, and optional shape_name/shape_color/shape_transform
            unit_nodes: Optional allowlisted single-instance ControlRig event RigVM unit node specs
            max_direct_curves: Maximum direct curve entries accepted
            max_direct_nulls: Maximum direct null entries accepted
            max_direct_controls: Maximum direct control entries accepted
            max_unit_nodes: Maximum RigVM unit node entries accepted; clamped to 6
            allow_existing_target_reuse: Reuse an existing ControlRig sample target
            overwrite_existing: Delete and recreate an existing target
            modular_rig: Create a modular rig instead of a standard ControlRig
            compile: Compile/initialize after creation or preview assignment
            save_asset: Save the target sample ControlRig asset
            dry_run: Validate without mutating assets
            validate_only: Alias for dry_run

catalog_tools.name: execute_unreal_python
catalog_tools.description:
Execute Python inside the running Unreal Editor.

        Source-code text is not used to decide import safety because aliases,
        getattr, helpers, and persistent Unreal Python globals can hide the
        eventual engine call. ``auto`` therefore conservatively behaves as
        ``legacy``: it runs standalone on the next editor tick, temporarily
        bypasses Interchange, and verifies restoration. This supports
        AssetImportTask/import_asset_tasks as well as
        AutomatedAssetImportData/import_assets_automated.

        Use ``preserve`` (or its ``interchange`` alias) for synchronous direct
        UInterchangeManager ``import_asset``, ``reimport_asset``, or
        ``import_scene`` calls and formats that require Interchange. A scripted
        async import must wait for completion and perform independent readback
        before the Python call returns; otherwise the bridge reports an unknown
        in-flight mutation and refuses a success result. Use ``none`` only when
        the script cannot import; it is a trusted caller declaration, not a
        sandbox, and avoids the import ticker/CVar scope. Declared import
        policies cannot run inside a synchronous batch/re-entrant command.

        Live Python asset Force Delete, Python-driven editor shutdown, map
        transitions, and unsafe PCG selector mutation remain rejected by focused
        accident guards. Generic Python execution is not a security sandbox.

        Args:
            code: Python code to execute in Unreal.
            mode: Python execution mode. ExecuteFile supports multiline TA scripts.
            defer_to_ticker: Run through Unreal ticker instead of directly on the game thread.
            allow_unsafe_editor_scripting_during_pie: Permit known unsafe editor actor cleanup calls during PIE/SIE.
            interchange_policy: Structured import execution policy. ``auto`` is the conservative legacy-compatible default; ``none`` declares no import; ``legacy`` selects legacy factories; ``preserve``/``interchange`` keep Interchange enabled for synchronous direct imports. Import-capable policies force standalone next-tick dispatch.

        Returns:
            Response from Unreal, including Python logs and command_result.

Read static Blueprint graph call/link topology.

        This command is read-only. It reports graph nodes, classified K2 node kinds,
        function/variable/event member references, asset/reference paths, and pin links.
        It does not prove runtime execution.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Blueprint name or path
            graph_name: Optional exact graph name selector
            graph_id: Optional graph GUID selector
            graph_type: Optional graph type selector: event, function, macro, delegate, or any
            graph_name_contains: Optional graph name substring filter
            node_type: Optional node class/title substring filter
            title_contains: Optional node title substring filter
            reference_contains: Optional substring filter across function, variable, event, pin, and reference text
            include_pins: Include full per-node pin metadata
            include_links: Include normalized pin links
            include_references: Include per-node reference_paths
            max_graphs: Maximum graphs to include, -1 for unlimited
            max_nodes_per_graph: Maximum matching nodes per graph, -1 for unlimited
            max_links_per_graph: Maximum links per graph, -1 for unlimited
            max_references_per_node: Maximum reference paths per node, -1 for unlimited

        Returns:
            Response containing static Blueprint graph topology.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_blueprint_networking_settings
catalog_tools.description: Inspect replication, dormancy, relevancy, frequency, and priority on an Actor Blueprint CDO.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_blueprint_niagara_component_template
catalog_tools.description:
Inspect Blueprint SCS Niagara component templates without writing assets.

        This read-only preflight loads a Blueprint asset, scans its own and
        optionally inherited SimpleConstructionScript component templates, and
        reports matching UNiagaraComponent asset assignment plus override
        parameter store data. It never saves, reloads, compiles, or mutates the
        Blueprint.

        Args:
            blueprint_path: Blueprint asset package or object path, e.g. /Game/MCPWeather/BP_MCPWeatherManager.
            component_name: Optional substring filter against SCS variable name, template name, path, or class.
            expected_system_path: Optional Niagara system package/object path to compare against the template assignment.
            parameter_name_contains: Optional substring filter for override parameter names.
            include_inherited_scs_templates: Include parent Blueprint SCS templates as resolved for the target generated class.
            require_exactly_one: Set preflight_pass=false unless exactly one template matches component_name.
            require_expected_system_match: Set preflight_pass=false unless all matching templates use expected_system_path.
            max_components: Maximum matching component templates to return.
            max_parameters: Maximum parameters to return per override store.
            include_parameter_values: Include decoded primitive/vector/color parameter values.
            include_raw_bytes: Include raw byte previews for unsupported parameter types.
            max_raw_bytes: Maximum bytes per unsupported parameter raw preview.
            include_parameter_object_properties: Include limited UPROPERTY previews for UObject/DataInterface parameter values.
            include_component_object_properties: Include limited reflected properties from the component template itself.
            max_object_properties: Maximum UObject/DataInterface or component properties to return.
            max_array_elements: Maximum array elements to sample per reflected property.
            max_property_value_chars: Maximum export-text characters per reflected property value.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_blueprint_variable_metadata
catalog_tools.description:
Inspect the exact metadata stored on one Blueprint member variable.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Name or asset path of the target Blueprint.
            variable_name: Exact member-variable name to inspect.

        Returns:
            A read-only response with ordered metadata entries, a convenience
            metadata object, and dirty-state evidence.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_blueprint_variables
catalog_tools.description:
Inspect Blueprint member variables and category sorting metadata.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Name or asset path of the target Blueprint.

        Returns:
            Response containing new/generated variables, pin types, metadata, and category sorting.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_chaos_cinematic_pipeline
catalog_tools.description: Inspect native hierarchy, proxy, anchor, cache, Sequencer, MRQ, and MCP independence.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_chaos_cloth_asset
catalog_tools.description:
Inspect native Chaos Cloth collections, properties, and Dataflow ownership.

        ``max_properties`` is clamped to 1..4096 and ``max_nodes`` to 1..2048.
        For durable edits, round-trip the returned ``dataflow_asset_path`` and
        a ``cloth_dataflow_nodes`` entry's ``name``/``type``. Supply only an
        ``editable_properties`` member marked ``supported_for_mcp_write`` and
        use its canonical ``export_text`` as the value/expected-current form.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_chaos_cloth_component
catalog_tools.description:
Inspect bounded Chaos Cloth component settings, properties, and metrics.

        Runtime collection reads are emitted only after a valid initialized
        outfit interactor is available. ``max_results`` bounds components and
        is clamped to 1..256; ``max_properties`` is one response-wide
        runtime-property budget clamped to 1..4096. Each component returns
        copy-ready ``expected_current_fields`` for serialized settings.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_chaos_cloth_simulation_mesh
catalog_tools.description:
Inspect one bounded UE 5.6 Chaos Cloth simulation-mesh LOD.

        The native route exposes simulation positions, normals, triangle
        indices, and a selected weight map even though ``UChaosClothAsset``
        does not expose those collection arrays to Unreal Python. Vertex and
        face paging keep large cloth assets within one bounded MCP response;
        use the returned totals and page metadata to request later ranges.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_chaos_solver_settings
catalog_tools.description:
Inspect Chaos Solver actor settings and optional UE 5.6 runtime state.

        Runtime output includes read-only diagnostics for the six allowlisted
        global CVars that can override iteration and collision actor values
        after ``FPBDRigidsSolver::ApplyConfig``. ``max_results`` is clamped to
        1..256. Each actor includes copy-ready ``expected_current_fields``;
        the response also lists ``writable_setting_names``.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_controlrig_rigvm_topology
catalog_tools.description:
Read ControlRig Blueprint default RigVM topology.

        This command is read-only. It loads a ControlRig Blueprint asset or a
        generated ControlRig class, resolves the owning ControlRig Blueprint,
        and returns bounded RigVM graph nodes, pins, links, event metadata, and
        dirty-state guards. It does not mutate, compile, save, or execute the
        ControlRig. Use this before proposing RigVM link or pin-default authoring.

        Args:
            control_rig_path: ControlRig Blueprint asset path or generated class path
            control_rig_asset_path: Explicit ControlRig Blueprint asset path alias
            control_rig_class_path: Generated ControlRig class path alias
            include_pins: Include bounded per-node pin metadata
            include_sub_pins: Include bounded recursive sub-pin metadata
            include_links: Include graph-level RigVM links
            include_pin_links: Include per-pin link path summaries
            max_nodes: Maximum nodes to include
            max_pins_per_node: Maximum top-level pins per node
            max_sub_pins_per_pin: Maximum sub-pins per pin at each level
            max_links: Maximum graph links to include

        Returns:
            Read-only ControlRig RigVM topology response.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_gas_blueprint
catalog_tools.description: Inspect GAS type, AbilitySystem components, and gameplay attributes on a Blueprint.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_geometry_collection_performance_guarded
catalog_tools.description: Read hierarchy, Tiny Geo, removal, Root Mesh Proxy, and optional runtime state.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_geometry_collection_runtime_state
catalog_tools.description:
Read per-piece Geometry Collection state from the active begun-play PIE world.

        The native command reads DynamicCollection, removal decay, render-world
        transforms, PhysicsObject transforms, velocities, and sleep/disabled
        states without mutating or saving the world. ``component_name`` and
        either ``actor_name`` or ``actor_label`` are required. Pass
        ``pie_instance`` when multiple begun-play PIE worlds exist.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_niagara_compile_status
catalog_tools.description:
Inspect Niagara script compile status and outstanding compile requests.
