            system_path: Niagara System package path or object path
            request_compile: Request a compile before returning status
            force: Force compile when request_compile is true
            allow_source_compile: Allow compile requests outside /Game/_MCP_Temp/NiagaraGenerated/
            wait_for_completion: Poll outstanding compile requests before returning
            timeout_seconds: Maximum wait time when wait_for_completion is true
            poll_interval_seconds: Poll interval when wait_for_completion is true

catalog_tools.name: inspect_niagara_component_grid2d_runtime
catalog_tools.description:
Read live Niagara Grid2D runtime NumCells from matching components.

        This is a read-only runtime probe for Grid2D smoke tests. It scans live
        Niagara components, finds Grid2D Collection data interfaces, and returns
        both static asset fields and game-thread runtime instance data when the
        system instance exposes it.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_niagara_component_parameter_store
catalog_tools.description:
Compare live Niagara override and instance parameter stores.

        This is a narrow wrapper around inspect_niagara_component_runtime_state
        for runtime User-parameter propagation probes. It returns component
        OverrideParameters and FNiagaraSystemInstance InstanceParameters with
        decoded primitive/vector/color values when a live system instance exists.

        Args:
            actor_name: Optional substring filter against actor name, label, or path.
            actor_label: Optional substring filter against actor label.
            component_name: Optional substring filter against component name or path.
            system_path: Optional substring filter against the assigned Niagara system path.
            parameter_name_contains: Optional substring filter for parameter names, e.g. V4_SeedEnabled.
            max_components: Maximum matching components to return.
            max_parameters: Maximum parameters to return per store.
            include_raw_bytes: Include raw byte previews for unsupported value types.
            max_raw_bytes: Maximum bytes per unsupported parameter raw preview.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_niagara_component_runtime_state
catalog_tools.description:
Inspect live Niagara state in PIE/SIE when active, otherwise the editor world.

        This is a read-only diagnostic route for comparing Blueprint-owned
        Niagara components after asset swaps. It serializes component metadata
        plus the component override parameter store, and optionally the live
        system-instance parameter store, without creating, mutating, loading,
        saving, reloading, compiling, or persisting content.

        Args:
            actor_name: Optional substring filter against actor name, label, or path.
            actor_label: Optional substring filter against actor label.
            component_name: Optional substring filter against component name or path.
            system_path: Optional substring filter against the assigned Niagara system path.
            parameter_name_contains: Optional substring filter for parameter names.
            max_components: Maximum matching components to return.
            max_parameters: Maximum parameters to return per store.
            include_parameter_values: Include decoded primitive/vector/color parameter values.
            include_raw_bytes: Include raw byte previews for unsupported parameter types.
            max_raw_bytes: Maximum bytes per unsupported parameter raw preview.
            include_asset_exposed_parameters: Also include assigned system exposed user parameter store.
            include_instance_parameters: Also include live FNiagaraSystemInstance parameter store when available.
            include_parameter_object_properties: Include limited UPROPERTY previews for UObject/DataInterface parameter values.
            include_emitter_runtime: Include live FNiagaraSystemInstance/FNiagaraEmitterInstance counters.
            max_emitter_instances: Maximum emitter runtime entries to return per component.
            max_object_properties: Maximum UObject/DataInterface properties to return per object.
            max_array_elements: Maximum array elements to sample per UObject/DataInterface property.
            max_property_value_chars: Maximum export-text characters per property value.

catalog_tools.name: inspect_physics_asset_constraints_guarded

Read PhysicsAsset bodies, constraints, profiles, and solver settings.

        Provide either physics_asset_path or skeletal_mesh_path. When a skeletal
        mesh is supplied, its assigned PhysicsAsset is resolved read-only. The
        command does not simulate physics, apply profiles, cook collision, save,
        or mutate assets.

            physics_asset_path: Explicit PhysicsAsset package path or object path
            skeletal_mesh_path: SkeletalMesh path used to resolve a PhysicsAsset
            include_bodies: Include bounded body setup summaries
            include_constraints: Include bounded constraint summaries
            include_profiles: Include asset, body, and constraint profile summaries
            include_solver_settings: Include RBAN solver settings
            include_collision_summary: Include shape counts and bounded shape summaries

            max_constraints: Maximum constraint templates to include
            max_profiles_per_item: Maximum profiles per body or constraint
            max_shapes_per_body: Maximum shape summaries per body
            require_supported_class: Return an error for unsupported classes when true

        Returns:
            Response containing read-only PhysicsAsset evidence and truncation flags.

Temporarily preview a Niagara System asset swap on one live component.

        This is an authoring-only BP manager parity route. It finds exactly one
        live editor UNiagaraComponent by the supplied actor/component/system
        filters, assigns the replacement Niagara System with override
        preservation, samples runtime and override state, then restores the
        original asset and active state before returning.

        Args:
            replacement_system_path: Niagara system object path or package path to test on the component.
            actor_name: Optional substring filter against actor name, label, or path.
            actor_label: Optional substring filter against actor label.
            component_name: Optional substring filter against component name or path, e.g. RainFX.
            system_path: Optional substring filter against the currently assigned Niagara system path.
            parameter_name_contains: Optional substring filter for parameter names.
            restore_original_asset: Must remain true. Persistent component asset swaps are not admitted by this tool.
            preserve_override_parameters: Must remain true. False can reset Blueprint component override state.
            activate_after_swap: Activate and advance the component after the temporary swap for runtime readback.
            advance_time: Seconds to advance simulation after the temporary swap.
            advance_tick_delta: Simulation tick size for the advance.
            max_parameters: Maximum parameters to return per store.
            max_emitter_instances: Maximum emitter runtime entries to return per component snapshot.
            include_parameter_values: Include decoded primitive/vector/color parameter values.
            include_raw_bytes: Include raw byte previews for unsupported parameter types.
            max_raw_bytes: Maximum bytes per unsupported parameter raw preview.
            include_parameter_object_properties: Include limited UPROPERTY previews for UObject/DataInterface parameter values.
            include_emitter_runtime: Include live system/emitter counters for the after-swap snapshot.
            max_object_properties: Maximum UObject/DataInterface properties to return per object.
            max_array_elements: Maximum array elements to sample per UObject/DataInterface property.
            max_property_value_chars: Maximum export-text characters per property value.

catalog_tools.name: preview_niagara_system_in_preview_lab

Run a one-call Niagara Preview Lab still preview.

        This optimized route loads a read-only Niagara system, deletes prior
        Preview Lab actors if requested, spawns one transient preview actor,
        applies optional component-only User parameter overrides, advances
        simulation for warmup, captures with auto framing, and optionally
        removes the actor afterward.

        Args:
            system_path: Niagara system object path or package path.
            filepath: PNG output path. Relative paths are resolved under Saved/MCP/NiagaraReviews.
            view: Near/mid/far distance hint, 1 to 3.
            label: Optional preview actor label suffix.
            warmup_time: Seconds to advance simulation before capture.
            warmup_tick_delta: Simulation tick size for warmup.
            cleanup_before: Delete existing Preview Lab actors before spawning.
            cleanup_after: Delete Preview Lab actors after capture.
            location: Optional [x, y, z] spawn location. Defaults to [0, 0, 120].
            scale: Optional [x, y, z] actor scale. Defaults to [1, 1, 1].
            auto_frame: Auto-frame temporary preview actors when present. Set false for manual camera captures.
            camera_location: Optional [x, y, z] capture camera location override.
            camera_rotation: Optional [pitch, yaw, roll] capture camera rotation override.
            camera_fov: Optional capture camera FOV override.
            user_parameter_overrides: Optional transient component overrides, e.g. {"Amount": 90000.0, "Custom Camera Position": [0, -3200, 650]}.
            preserve_override_parameters: Preserve existing component override parameters when assigning the system. Keep true for Blueprint/component swap parity.
            allow_current_map_preview: Allow preview capture in the current editor map when the dedicated Preview Lab map is unavailable.

catalog_tools.name: sample_anim_node_pre_post_runtime_pose
catalog_tools.description:
Resolve a target AnimGraph node or run a limited runtime probe.

        With dry_run=True this is a read-only target resolver. With dry_run=False,
        mode="compiled_graph_mapping" maps the selected editor AnimGraph node to
        the compiled/live FAnimNode instance on a matched AnimInstance and reports
        runtime FPoseLink/FComponentSpacePoseLink link IDs plus mapping_support
        diagnostics for PoseWatch eligibility and evidence tier. With
        mode="pose_watch_capture", it temporarily sets the AnimBP debug object,
        registers transient PoseWatch debug entries for the selected compiled
        node output and selected runtime input pose link(s), and samples them
        during the same forced tick without adding PoseWatches to the AnimBP asset.
        With
        mode="active_component_tick_delta" samples final SkeletalMeshComponent pose
        before and after forced ticks on a matched live component. With
        mode="isolated_temp_components", it duplicates the AnimBP under _MCP_Temp,
        bypasses the selected node in a source copy, and compares that against a
        selected-node copy on separate transient components.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Anim Blueprint name or path
            anim_blueprint: Alternative Anim Blueprint name or path
            graph_name: AnimGraph graph name, defaults to AnimGraph
            graph_id: Optional graph GUID
            graph_type: Graph type, defaults to function for AnimGraph
            node_id: Exact target node GUID. Required when filters are ambiguous.
            node_type: Node class/title filter such as AnimGraphNode_RigidBody
            title_contains: Node title substring filter
            sample_bones: Optional future sample bone list echoed in the response
            sample_sockets: Optional future sample socket list echoed in the response
            mode: Runtime mode for dry_run=False. compiled_graph_mapping, pose_watch_capture, active_component_tick_delta, or isolated_temp_components.
            skeletal_mesh: SkeletalMesh path required by isolated_temp_components
            temp_root: Temp asset root for isolated_temp_components
            cleanup: Delete transient actors/temp assets after isolated sampling
            overwrite_existing_temp_assets: Replace colliding temp assets
            run_id: Optional stable suffix for generated temp asset/actor names
            actor_label: Live actor label to sample for active_component_tick_delta
            actor_name: Live actor object name to sample
            actor_path: Live actor object path to sample
            component_name: SkeletalMeshComponent name to sample
            anim_instance_source: AnimInstance source on the sampled component: main or post_process
            prefer_pie_world: Prefer PIE/SIE/play worlds over editor world
            require_pie_world: Refuse editor-world fallback
            tick_count: Forced tick count between pre/post samples
            tick_delta_time: Delta time for forced ticks
            settle_tick_count: Forced ticks before taking the pre sample
            refresh_bone_transforms: Refresh bone transforms after forced ticks
            allow_missing_bones: Return partial samples instead of failing on missing bones/sockets
            pose_link_max_depth: Max struct recursion depth for compiled_graph_mapping and pose_watch_capture runtime pose-link inventory
            input_pose_mode: PoseWatch input selection mode: first or all
            input_pose_field_path: Exact runtime pose-link field path to capture
            input_pose_index: Zero-based valid runtime pose-link index to capture
            include_pins: Include full pin data for the selected node
            max_depth: Reflected settings depth
            dry_run: Resolve only when true; run the selected mode when false

        Returns:
            Resolver response or selected runtime probe response, including
            mapping_support when node attribution diagnostics are available.

catalog_tools.name: sample_anim_state_machine_runtime_response
catalog_tools.description:
Apply runtime AnimInstance property cases, tick narrowly, and sample state-machine response.

        This is a runtime probe only. By default it restores each successfully
        changed property after the case and never saves Animation Blueprint assets.

        Args:
            actor_label: Optional actor label filter
            actor_name: Optional actor object name filter
            actor_path: Optional actor path filter
            component_name: Optional SkeletalMeshComponent object name
            cases: Case list. Each case can include name, properties, tick_count, tick_delta_time, restore_after_case.
            properties: Single-case property map used when cases is omitted
            name: Single-case name used when cases is omitted
            tick_count: Default forced component animation tick count per case
            tick_delta_time: Default delta time per forced tick
            refresh_bone_transforms: Refresh component bone transforms during/after forced ticks when tick_count > 0
            restore_after_case: Restore successful property changes after each case
            include_baseline: Capture state before cases
            state_machine_name: Optional state-machine name substring filter
            include_states: Include per-state metadata
            include_state_weights: Include runtime state/machine weights
            include_relevant_anim_times: Include relevant asset-player time/remaining values per state
            include_transition_progress: Include active transition elapsed/crossfade progress
            include_inactive_transition_progress: Include inactive transition progress entries
            include_montages: Include active montage data
            include_curves: Include curve values
            curve_names: Optional curve names
            max_state_machines: Maximum state machines to include
            max_state_machine_instances_to_probe: Maximum runtime AnimNode indexes to probe
            max_states_per_machine: Maximum states per included machine
            max_transitions_per_machine: Maximum transitions per included machine for transition progress
            max_curves: Maximum curves to include
            prefer_pie_world: Prefer active PIE/SIE/play world before editor world
            require_pie_world: Fail instead of falling back to the editor world when no PIE/SIE/play world matches

        Returns:
            Response containing baseline and per-case state-machine snapshots.

catalog_tools.name: sample_blendspace_runtime_pose_grid
catalog_tools.description:
Evaluate BlendSpace inputs on a transient runtime SkeletalMeshActor and sample bone/socket poses.

        This command does not start SIE by itself. By default it requires an active
        PIE/SIE/play world, spawns a transient SkeletalMeshActor, configures
        AnimationSingleNode BlendSpace playback, applies each requested input,
        forces narrow component ticks, samples requested bones/sockets, and cleans
        up the transient actor without saving assets.

        Args:
            skeletal_mesh: SkeletalMesh asset path for the transient probe actor
            blendspace_path: Single BlendSpace asset path
            blendspaces: Optional list of BlendSpace paths or objects with path/name/samples
            samples: Optional sample inputs for single blendspace_path. Each object may include label and input or x/y/z.
            sample_bones: Bone names to sample. Defaults to key humanoid bones in C++.
            sample_sockets: Socket names to sample
            actor_label: Transient actor label
            sample_time: Single-node playback time applied before sampling
            settle_tick_count: Forced ticks after setting each input before final tick
            tick_count: Forced ticks immediately before sampling
            tick_delta_time: Delta time for forced component ticks
            include_axis_extremes: Include min/center/max axis probes when samples are not supplied
            allow_missing_bones: Return partial sample data instead of failing on missing bones/sockets
            refresh_bone_transforms: Refresh bones after each forced tick
            cleanup: Destroy transient actor before returning
            prefer_pie_world: Prefer active PIE/SIE/play worlds over editor world
            require_pie_world: Fail without active PIE/SIE/play world

        Returns:
            Response with per-BlendSpace sample poses, weighted source samples, and deltas from each BlendSpace's first valid sample.

                loc or interaction_world_location, curves, and control_values.
            sample_elements: Optional hierarchy element names or {type, name} objects
            control_values: Optional transient Float/EulerTransform hierarchy control values
            execute_events: Optional ControlRig event names to execute, default Forwards Solve
            should_trace_property: Property name used by shorthand should_trace
            interaction_location_property: Property name used by shorthand loc

catalog_tools.name: sample_niagara_system_in_preview_lab
catalog_tools.description:
Capture multiple Niagara Preview Lab candidates in one MCP round trip.

        Use this when a Niagara effect is timing-sensitive or not visible in the

        captures each candidate with auto framing, and returns sample metadata.

        Args:
            system_path: Niagara system object path or package path.
            output_dir: Relative output folder under Saved/MCP/NiagaraReviews.
            label: File and actor label stem.
            warmup_times: Seconds to advance simulation before each capture.
            views: Near/mid/far distance hints, values 1 to 3.
            warmup_tick_delta: Simulation tick size for warmup.
            cleanup_before: Delete existing Preview Lab actors before sampling.
            cleanup_after_each: Delete the sample actor after each capture.
            cleanup_after_all: Final cleanup pass after all samples.
            location: Optional [x, y, z] spawn location.
            scale: Optional [x, y, z] actor scale.
            auto_frame: Auto-frame temporary preview actors when present. Set false for manual camera captures.
            camera_location: Optional [x, y, z] capture camera location override.
            camera_rotation: Optional [pitch, yaw, roll] capture camera rotation override.
            camera_fov: Optional capture camera FOV override.
            user_parameter_overrides: Optional transient component overrides applied to each sample actor.
            preserve_override_parameters: Preserve existing component override parameters when assigning the system for each sample.
            allow_current_map_preview: Allow sampling in the current editor map when the dedicated Preview Lab map is unavailable.

catalog_tools.name: sample_render_target2d_region_stats
catalog_tools.description:
Read a TextureRenderTarget2D once and return region/channel statistics.

        This is an authoring-only readback probe for render-target smoke tests.
        It computes count, sum, max, threshold-hit bounds, centroid, optional
        same-read probe stats, and first-hit samples in C++ so tests do not
        need slow per-pixel Python loops.

        Args:
            render_target_path: RT package/object path.
            x0, x1, y0, y1: Inclusive pixel region. Negative x1/y1 uses the RT maximum bound.
            channel: r, g, b, a, luma, or max. Default max checks any channel.
            threshold: Strictly-greater-than threshold for nonzero classification.
            max_first_hits: Maximum hit samples returned for debugging.
            probe_x, probe_y: Optional probe center. Set both to >= 0 to return same-read probe stats.
            probe_radius: Inclusive square probe radius in pixels.

catalog_tools.name: validate_controlrig_rigvm_links
catalog_tools.description:
Validate proposed ControlRig RigVM links without mutating the graph.

        This command is read-only. It resolves a ControlRig Blueprint asset or
        generated ControlRig class, finds the requested RigVM pins, reports
        existing-link state, and calls Unreal's RigVM CanLink path for each
        bounded link spec. It does not add links, compile, save, execute, or
        solve the ControlRig.

        Args:
            control_rig_path: ControlRig Blueprint asset path or generated class path
            control_rig_asset_path: Explicit ControlRig Blueprint asset path alias
            control_rig_class_path: Generated ControlRig class path alias
            links: Link specs with source_pin_path/from and target_pin_path/to, or "Source -> Target" strings
            unit_links: Alias for links, useful when checking previously rejected unit link specs
            allow_type_casting: Allow RigVM type casting during CanLink validation
            max_links: Maximum link specs to validate

        Returns:
            Read-only ControlRig RigVM link feasibility response.

catalog_tools.name: validate_controlrig_rigvm_pin_defaults
catalog_tools.description:
Validate ControlRig RigVM pin default feasibility without writing values.

        This command is read-only. It resolves a ControlRig Blueprint asset or
        generated ControlRig class, finds requested RigVM pins, reports current
        default value metadata, and validates any proposed default strings with
        Unreal's RigVM pin default-value checks. It does not call
        SetPinDefaultValue, resize arrays, compile, save, execute, or solve.

        Args:
            control_rig_path: ControlRig Blueprint asset path or generated class path
            control_rig_asset_path: Explicit ControlRig Blueprint asset path alias
            control_rig_class_path: Generated ControlRig class path alias
            pin_defaults: Pin specs with pin_path/pin/path and optional default_value/value/default
            defaults: Alias for pin_defaults
            pins: Alias for pin_defaults, useful for read-only pin capability checks
            max_pins: Maximum pin specs to validate

        Returns:
            Read-only ControlRig RigVM pin default feasibility response.

catalog_tools.name: validate_controlrig_solver_intents
catalog_tools.description:
Validate future ControlRig solver intents through the UnrealMCP native bridge.

        This is a validation-only UnrealMCP C++ route. It accepts a request or
        recipe-like object with solver_gate and solver_intents, verifies that the
        intents are limited to validation-only candidates, rejects materialized
        solver RigVM units, and reports that sample/temp live proof is still
        required before any build path may add solver units.

        Args:
            request: JSON object or string with target_control_rig_path,
                solver_gate, solver_intents, and optional recipe hierarchy.

catalog_tools.name: validate_niagara_effect_patch
catalog_tools.description:
Validate an objective-based Niagara patch without executing it.

        Every objective must define a measurable expected observation and a
        rollback policy. Operations are restricted to the existing reviewed
        Niagara command allowlist, share one exact system path, and default to
        generated temp content. A valid response includes a non-dispatched
        execute_batch manifest; execution always requires a separate explicit
        tool call.

        Args:
            patch: Versioned objective-patch object.
            effect_spec: Optional ParticleEffectSpec for exact working-path binding.
            allow_non_temp_target: Validate a non-temp path for planning only;
                this never approves or performs mutation and does not bypass promotion.

catalog_tools.name: validate_niagara_effect_spec
catalog_tools.description:
Validate a ParticleEffectSpec and its emitter dependency graph.

        Validation covers schema version, emitter/objective identity, module
        stages, material and system asset paths, dependency cycles, temp working
        scope, promotion requirements, plugin independence, selective rollback,
        and best-state selection. This tool is mutation-free.

catalog_tools.name: validate_pcg_source_independence
catalog_tools.description:
Validate that a PCG graph avoids forbidden source dependencies.

        This is a focused wrapper around audit_pcg_graph_contract for promoted
        source-independent rebuilds. By default it forbids PCGStudy references.

catalog_tools.name: wrap_niagara_scratch_pad_output_with_stack_context
catalog_tools.description:
Wrap a Scratch Pad ParameterMapSet value input with a Custom HLSL accumulator.

        The existing linked value becomes local_value_pin_name, while the expression can
        read the incoming StackContext through the dynamic input's ParameterMap.

        Args:
            system_path: Niagara System package path or object path
            target_pin_name: ParameterMapSet input pin to wrap, defaults to StackContext.RGBA
            scratch_pad_script_path: Direct target Scratch Pad script path
            scratch_pad_owner_kind: system or emitter
            scratch_pad_script_index: Scratch Pad script index
            scratch_pad_name: Scratch Pad script name, defaults to RenderCircleToGrid
            scratch_pad_emitter_index: Optional emitter index for emitter-owned Scratch Pads
            scratch_pad_emitter_name: Optional emitter name for emitter-owned Scratch Pads
            target_node_guid: Optional target ParameterMapSet node GUID
            target_node_index: Optional graph node index from inspect_niagara_graph
            parameter_map_set_index: Optional ParameterMapSet-only index in the Scratch Pad graph
            previous_stack_value_pin_name: Custom HLSL input name for the incoming StackContext value
            local_value_pin_name: Custom HLSL input name for the previous linked value
            expression: Dynamic Custom HLSL expression, defaults to max(PreviousStackValue, LocalStampValue)
            skip_if_already_wrapped: Return success when the same Custom HLSL wrapper already exists
            replace_existing_custom: Replace an existing Custom HLSL wrapper while preserving local_value_pin_name
            allow_source_edit: Allow edits outside /Game/_MCP_Temp
            save: Save the Niagara System after editing
            request_compile: Request Niagara compile after editing
